mandatoryCriteria: Edit own comment: PATCH /api/v1/comments/:commentId allows author to edit comment body and mentions
Non-author prohibition: Non-author project members or managers cannot edit someone else's comment (403 FORBIDDEN)
OCC version check: Verifies expectedVersion against comment version; increments version on success; returns 409 STALE_VERSION on conflict
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Comment author editing with OCC.
